newsitem.title: CANADA: Express Pipeline has no room for stalled IPL oil.
newsitem.headline: Express Pipeline has no room for stalled IPL oil.

text.p: The new Express Pipeline to Wyoming from Alberta has no capacity available for volumes unable to move on the crippled IPL Energy Inc system, a company spokeswoman said on Monday.
"From our point of view, our system is at capacity," Express's Florence Murphy said by telephone from Casper, Wyoming.

First shipments on the 172,000 barrel per day Express line, co-owned by Alberta Energy Co Ltd and TransCanada PipeLines Ltd, reached Casper on Saturday following a nine-week, 2.2 million barrel line fill operation.
Express also offers access to southern Illinois refineries through the Platte pipeline system, which it owns.
Much of IPL's Interprovincial Pipe Line system was shut down on Saturday after a power failure in storm-battered Minnesota knocked out three pumping stations.
IPL said it did not believe the stations could be back on line before Wednesday.
